input.title: Critical RCE in Fortinet FortiGate exploited in the wild, patch now
input.body: Fortinet has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-31337, a pre-auth remote code execution flaw in FortiGate appliances. A fix is available in FortiOS 7.6.4.

input.title: Ransomware gang leaks 2TB of data stolen from European hospital group
input.body: The Qilin ransomware group published data allegedly exfiltrated from a hospital network spanning Germany, France and Austria after ransom negotiations collapsed.

input.title: Microsoft: Chinese state actor breached government email via token forgery
input.body: Microsoft disclosed that Storm-0558 forged authentication tokens to access email accounts at US government agencies. Microsoft revoked the key and published IOCs.

input.title: Federal Reserve holds rates steady, signals two cuts this year
input.body: The US central bank kept its benchmark rate unchanged and updated projections indicating two quarter-point cuts by year end. Markets rallied on the news.

input.title: Supply-chain attack on npm package 'httpkit' backdoors 4M weekly downloads
input.body: A maintainer account compromise led to malicious versions of httpkit being published. The payload exfiltrates environment variables. Versions 3.2.1-3.2.3 affected.

input.title: Parliament passes sweeping data protection reform after marathon session
input.body: Lawmakers in Brazil approved amendments strengthening the national data protection authority's enforcement powers and raising maximum fines.

input.title: DDoS attack takes Estonian government portals offline for six hours
input.body: A hacktivist group claimed a volumetric DDoS attack that disrupted Estonian e-government services. Services restored with upstream filtering.

input.title: Semiconductor giant announces $40B fab expansion in Arizona
input.body: The chipmaker will build two additional fabrication plants, citing AI demand. Construction begins next year with state and federal incentives.

input.title: CISA orders federal agencies to patch actively exploited Chrome zero-day
input.body: CISA added CVE-2026-2882, exploited in targeted campaigns, to the KEV catalog with a 7-day deadline. Google shipped a fix in Chrome 138.

input.title: Data breach at retailer LoomMart exposes 8.4 million customer records
input.body: LoomMart confirmed attackers accessed a customer database via a compromised vendor account. Names, emails, hashed passwords and partial payment data exposed.

input.title: Champions League final ends in dramatic penalty shootout
input.body: The final was decided on penalties after a 2-2 draw, with the goalkeeper saving twice to seal the title.

input.title: PoC exploit released for critical Jenkins CLI file-read vulnerability
input.body: Researchers published a proof-of-concept for CVE-2026-20991 allowing unauthenticated file reads on Jenkins controllers. Scanning activity observed.

input.title: WHO declares end to regional cholera outbreak after vaccination push
input.body: Health authorities credited a coordinated vaccination campaign and water infrastructure repairs for containing the year-long outbreak.

input.title: VMware ESXi hypervisor flaw allows sandbox escape, patches released
input.body: Broadcom released fixes for CVE-2026-22945, a use-after-free allowing VM escape, demonstrated at Pwn2Own. Affects ESXi 8.x and 7.x.

input.title: Okta warns of credential-stuffing wave targeting customer identity endpoints
input.body: Okta observed a spike in credential-stuffing from residential proxies and recommends breached-password detection and rate limits.

input.title: Ceasefire talks collapse as strikes resume in border region
input.body: Negotiations broke down overnight after both sides accused each other of violations. Artillery strikes resumed, displacing an estimated 40,000 residents.

input.title: Magnitude 7.1 earthquake strikes coastal region, tsunami warning issued
input.body: Authorities issued tsunami warnings for three provinces and began evacuating low-lying areas. Early reports indicate structural damage in the regional capital.

input.title: G20 summit ends with joint statement on debt relief framework
input.body: Leaders agreed on a framework for restructuring sovereign debt for low-income countries, with implementation details to be negotiated by finance ministers.

input.title: India beat Australia by five wickets in a last-over T20 thriller in Bengaluru
input.body: Chasing 187, Suryakumar Yadav's unbeaten 78 sealed the series 2-1 for India as Australia's death bowling faltered again.

input.title: Real Madrid sign Brazilian winger in record €120m transfer
input.body: The La Liga club confirmed the five-year deal, making the 21-year-old the most expensive signing in Spanish football history.

input.title: OpenAI rival releases open-weights model claiming GPT-5-class reasoning
input.body: The startup published benchmark results and weights for a 200B-parameter mixture-of-experts model, intensifying the open-source AI race.

input.title: TSMC breaks ground on second Arizona fab as chip demand surges
input.body: The $28bn plant will produce 2nm chips from 2028, deepening US onshoring of advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

input.title: Sensex falls 900 points as foreign investors pull out of Indian equities
input.body: The BSE benchmark logged its worst session in four months amid a global risk-off move; the rupee touched a record low against the dollar.

input.title: RBI holds repo rate, signals prolonged pause amid sticky food inflation
input.body: India's central bank kept the policy rate at 6.5% for the ninth consecutive meeting while trimming its FY27 growth forecast.

input.title: Bitcoin crosses $150,000 for the first time on ETF inflow wave
input.body: Spot ETF holdings hit a record as institutional allocations accelerated; altcoins rallied in sympathy.

input.title: Lok Sabha passes data protection amendment after heated debate
input.body: The bill expands consent requirements for data processing and creates a new appellate tribunal; opposition parties staged a walkout.

input.title: Exit polls point to hung parliament in state assembly elections
input.body: Three of four exit polls show no party crossing the majority mark, setting up coalition negotiations next week.

input.title: WHO declares end to mpox public health emergency
input.body: The agency cited falling case counts across 40 countries and improved vaccine coverage in the hardest-hit regions.

input.title: Shah Rukh Khan action sequel smashes opening-day box office record
input.body: The film grossed ₹95 crore domestically on day one, the biggest opening in Hindi cinema history.

input.title: ISRO's Gaganyaan crewed test flight completes orbital rehearsal
input.body: The uncrewed precursor mission validated crew module re-entry and splashdown recovery in the Bay of Bengal.

input.title: Monsoon floods displace thousands across Assam as rivers breach banks
input.body: The Brahmaputra crossed danger levels at nine stations; the state opened 200 relief camps.

input.title: Tata Motors spins off EV unit in $10bn listing
input.body: The demerger creates India's largest pure-play EV maker; shares of the parent rose 4% on the announcement.
